name: ZEUS – Review Intelligence for WooCommerce
author: zeusinsight

sections.description:
Understand what your customers are telling you, without reading every review.

ZEUS – Review Intelligence for WooCommerce helps you spot recurring complaints,
find the products that need attention, and see which issues are new or getting worse.

See what needs your attention

  • Find your biggest customer complaint and most affected product.
  • Compare complaint mentions over the last 30 days with the previous 30 days.
  • Open the products and reviews behind each insight.
  • Analyze existing reviews when you get started.
  • Choose whether to analyze new reviews automatically.
  • Review suggested moderation actions and decide what to do.

Start with 100 analyses each month

The free Review Intelligence service includes 100 analyses per store each month.
This allowance is shared by your first analysis of existing reviews, analysis of
new reviews, and any fresh reanalysis you request. The allowance resets on the
first day of each month, using UTC.

Previously analyzed reviews are skipped during onboarding. Requesting a fresh
analysis of a review uses another analysis. An analysis counts once the service
accepts it for processing; checking its progress does not use more of your allowance.

When you reach your limit, your existing insights and manual moderation tools
remain available. You can analyze more reviews after your allowance resets.
The upgrade button lets you express interest in a future paid plan. It does not
charge you or change your plan.

You’re in control

Activating the plugin does not send your reviews for analysis. You first choose
to connect your store after reviewing the usage and privacy information.
Automatic approval is off by default. You can manage automatic analysis and
moderation in Settings.

Review analysis uses an external service operated by ZeusInLabs. You need
WooCommerce and a public HTTPS store to connect. See External services below
for details about the information shared.

External services

Review Intelligence

Review Intelligence, operated by ZeusInLabs, connects your store, processes
review analysis, and tracks your monthly allowance.

When you choose to connect, the plugin sends your store name, public website
address, and secure connection details. The service checks that the website
belongs to your store.

After connection, analysis sends the review text, star rating, product name,
whether the reviewer is a verified buyer, and references that link each analysis
to the correct review. This happens during onboarding,
when you request analysis, or when automatic analysis is enabled for new reviews.
The plugin also checks analysis progress and your remaining allowance.

Reviewer names, email addresses, and IP addresses are not sent as separate
fields. Personal information written inside the review text is not automatically
removed and is sent with that text.

If you click the upgrade-interest button, the service records your store’s
interest and current usage. No payment is collected.

  • Service website
  • Privacy Policy
  • Terms of Service

OpenRouter

Review Intelligence uses OpenRouter to provide AI analysis. It shares review
text, star rating, product name, and whether the reviewer is a verified buyer
with OpenRouter. Your store’s secure connection details are not shared with
the AI model.

  • OpenRouter website
  • Privacy Policy
  • Terms of Service
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is active on your store.
  2. Install and activate the plugin.
  3. Open Review Intelligence in your WordPress sidebar.
  4. Read the usage and privacy information, then choose to connect and analyze your reviews. You can also skip this step.
  5. View your insights and choose your automation preferences in Settings.
sections.faq:
What if I already have hundreds or thousands of reviews?

Onboarding starts with your newest reviews that still need analysis, up to your
remaining monthly allowance. It skips reviews already analyzed. The rest can
be analyzed in a later month.

Will it automatically approve my reviews?

Automatic approval is off by default. Onboarding and manual analysis do not
change a review’s approval status. You can enable automatic approval separately
in Settings. Your existing WordPress and WooCommerce moderation rules still apply.

Do I need to set up an AI account?

No. You connect your store from the plugin, and Review Intelligence handles the analysis.

What happens if analysis fails?

Your review stays unchanged. If you were reanalyzing a review, its previous
result is preserved. Temporary failures may be retried automatically, and you
can try again from the plugin.

Why aren’t complaint trends showing yet?

Trends compare the last 30 days with the previous 30 days, using review dates.
Both periods need complete analysis coverage before comparisons appear.
Changes reflect the number of complaint mentions, not the percentage of customers complaining.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

Uninstalling removes the plugin’s settings, connection details and saved analysis
from your WordPress site. Your WooCommerce products and customer reviews stay
intact. Deactivating the plugin keeps your settings and results.
Uninstalling does not delete your hosted service account; contact
reviewintelligence@zeusinlabs.com about data held by the service.
